block.slimic.command_pedestal.tooltip: Hold a damaged ancient core and right-click with one Ancient Command Seal and one slimeball in your inventory. Mine cores instead use one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball here in the Overworld.
item.slimic.abundance_slime.tooltip: Select Nurture to heal companions and encourage nearby plant growth. Healing uses slimeballs; plant growth uses stamina.
item.slimic.ancient_kingdom_map.unbound: Use in The Slimic to search for a Fallen Sanctum.
item.slimic.ancient_mining_slime.tooltip: A restored Mining Slime that prioritizes ores in its current layer and uses half stamina for work and movement.
item.slimic.ancient_tunnel_slime.tooltip: A restored Tunnel Slime that uses half stamina for work and movement and mines ancient Slimic masonry 50% faster with an effective tool.
item.slimic.assembly_clue.bound: Marks an assembly chamber. The clue is not an entry key.
item.slimic.assembly_clue.unbound: Use in The Slimic to search for an assembly chamber.
item.slimic.attention_slime.tooltip: Roams playfully with 50% higher Movement Speed at identical base stats. Can be used for basic specializations, retaining invested stats while losing Attention behavior and its speed bonus.
item.slimic.bound_combat_slime.tooltip: Combines both members' health; base Attack is 60% of their combined Attack values.
item.slimic.bound_transport_slime.toolti: Two cord-linked Transport Slimes move separately and share one bag and order.
item.slimic.cleaning_slime.tooltip: Select Clean to collect nearby dropped items into its bag. Transport companions can unload it when full.
item.slimic.cohesion_shard.tooltip: Four shards make one Colony Heart. Earn two on a repeat assembly clear.
item.slimic.colony.stored_only: Obtain by binding two companions at a Colony Bonding Station. An empty display icon cannot summon.
item.slimic.colony_heart.tooltip: A first assembly victory grants this heart. Craft a reusable Colony Bonding Station.
item.slimic.combat_slime.tooltip: Equip a sword and select Fight to attack enabled target types. Supports a shield, Slime Armor, and a loot bag.
item.slimic.commander_slime.tooltip: Right-click for companion records, tags, sharing, and Gather. Gather spends 25 stamina and arrivals wait. One released Command Slime per connected shared-owner group.
item.slimic.companion.summon_tooltip: Use on a block or water source to summon this companion. Initially waits.
item.slimic.damaged_ancient_slime_core.m: In the Overworld, use a Slime Restoration Station with one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball.
item.slimic.damaged_ancient_slime_core.t: Use on a Slime Restoration Station with one Ancient Command Seal and one slimeball in your inventory.
Restores with 12–28 invested upgrades in useful stats; each core keeps its own roll.
item.slimic.dragon_slime.tooltip: Equip a sword and select Fight for flying melee and targeted flame breath. Shares Combat Slime target filters and equipment.
item.slimic.ender_slime.tooltip: With full stamina, an empty hand, and a free main-inventory slot, right-click to anchor it and obtain a bound Slime Teleporter. Linking and teleporting each spend full stamina; Follow releases the anchor.
item.slimic.endless_assembly_record.tool: Use to read the observations left beside the assembly chamber.
item.slimic.farmer_slime.tooltip: Select Farm to harvest and replant registered crops. Needs a hoe and matching planting supplies.
item.slimic.fishing_slime.tooltip: Equip a fishing rod and select Fish to catch items from nearby water. Uses native fishing loot and rod enchantments.
item.slimic.friendly_slime.manage_toolti: Right-click with a Slime Tuner to manage; use a Slime Scanner to preview work areas.
item.slimic.friendly_slime.stored_toolti: Right-click to summon this companion in Wait mode with its saved traits.
item.slimic.friendly_slime.tooltip: A companion that follows you and grows through activity. Combine it with other ingredients to specialize its work or abilities.
item.slimic.glow_slime.tooltip: Provides torch-strength light without stamina cost. Right-click to spend 10 stamina on six-second fireflies; Light can be toggled separately.
item.slimic.guardian_angel_slime.tooltip: A flying protector that retaliates against nearby attackers. A reserve totem can rescue its owner from lethal damage within 16 blocks.
item.slimic.healing_slime.tooltip: Select Search to treat injured companions and revive Broken Slimes. Each treatment needs one slimeball from its bag.
item.slimic.herald_slime.tooltip: Select Watch to report blocked work with its saved firework design. Right-click to launch a manual signal.
item.slimic.kingdom_map_fragment.tooltip: Found in mines and ruins in The Slimic. Combine three to reconstruct an Ancient Kingdom Map.
item.slimic.last_rally_record.tooltip: Use to read a slime observer’s record of the last assembly order.
item.slimic.lumberjack_slime.tooltip: Select Chop to harvest natural trees and replant them. Needs an axe and matching saplings.
item.slimic.meow_slime.tooltip: Repels nearby creepers while Active, even during Wait. Roam and the creeper-repelling aura can be controlled independently.
item.slimic.mining_slime.tooltip: Select Mine to excavate its chunk with a pickaxe and shovel. Fluids require an empty bucket in its bag; wall repairs use cobblestone.
item.slimic.next_generation_mining_slime: A compact mining veteran with half stamina costs, inherited growth, and precision prospecting.
item.slimic.next_generation_tunnel_slime: A compact royal Tunnel Slime with a configurable square bore and inherited ancient efficiency.
item.slimic.royal_courtyard_seal.tooltip: The courtyard memory persists even if this seal is lost.
item.slimic.royal_gallery_seal.tooltip: The gallery memory persists even if this seal is lost.
item.slimic.royal_guard_slime.tooltip: Select Fight to defend its assigned post. With a shield, it takes part of nearby allies' combat damage.
item.slimic.royal_survey_compass.tooltip: Use inside the Fallen Sanctum to follow a horizontal bearing inward.
item.slimic.royal_synthesis_core.tooltip: One shared core per sanctum. Crafts a reusable Royal Synthesis Station.
item.slimic.saddle_slime.tooltip: Ride with a saddle; equip elytra for flight. Boost (default: Ctrl) accelerates movement and spends extra stamina. Descends slowly if stamina runs out during flight.
item.slimic.slime_armor.tooltip: Equip in a Combat, Dragon, or Saddle Slime's armor slot. Retains the original chestplate's attributes and data.
item.slimic.slime_scanner.detail: Hold in either hand to keep the preview (15s).
item.slimic.slime_scanner.tooltip: Right-click your slime to preview its work area.
item.slimic.slime_teleporter.bound: Linked to an Ender Slime. A full stamina bar is required at the destination.
item.slimic.slime_teleporter.unbound: Link a fully rested Ender Slime to obtain a usable teleporter.
item.slimic.soggy_slime.tooltip: Leaves harvestable slime trails while moving in Follow or Roam. Wait stops trail placement.
item.slimic.synthesis.unspent: Unused points remain available even when training limits are reached.
item.slimic.transport_slime.tooltip: Select Haul to collect requested cargo and deliver supplies from storage. Capacity is always twice that of a regular worker with the same base stats.
item.slimic.tunnel_slime.tooltip: Select Tunnel to bore a 3×3 passage in the chosen direction. Needs mining tools, lining blocks, and an empty bucket for fluids.
item.slimic.warehouse_slime.tooltip: Select Store to collect cargo and supply workers. Retains collected cargo in its own bag, with four times a Transport Slime's Capacity at identical stats.
equipment.slimic.head: Head
policy.slimic.normal: Normal: excavate the current chunk using ordinary mining rules.
policy.slimic.ore_priority: Ore Priority: prefer visible ores in the active layer.
policy.slimic.precision_prospecting: Precision Prospecting: dig a 2×2 shaft, detect selected ores through walls, and excavate safe branches to them.
screen.slimic.bonding.retained: Unused points: mean rounded down. One point upgrades each uncapped member; both capped spends none. Growth is halved while any role stat can upgrade both, otherwise normal. Unbinding copies the balance to both and returns them in Wait with their records and remaining vitals. Member one supplies combat gear. Creative point edits change the pool; stat edits affect both.
screen.slimic.capacity_occupied: Empty the bag slots that would become unavailable before reducing Capacity.
screen.slimic.capacity_unrepresentable: The colony’s combined bag exceeds the supported size.
screen.slimic.command_help: Companion roster: sharing and Gather. Gather: 25 stamina; arrivals wait.
screen.slimic.ender_help: At full stamina, right-click empty-handed with a free inventory slot to link. Linking and teleporting spend all stamina. Follow releases the anchor.
screen.slimic.glow_help: Light uses no stamina. Right-click for fireflies: 10 stamina, 6 seconds.
screen.slimic.guardian_help:
Totem reserve: up to 64.
Retaliates with a beam against attackers of itself or its owner. Uses one totem to protect its owner from lethal damage within 16 blocks.
screen.slimic.invalid_tuning: Enter finite, valid numbers; slots and points need whole numbers.
screen.slimic.lining_help: Lining template: click with a block to copy its type; the held stack is unchanged. Empty click clears it. Changing it pauses work.
screen.slimic.name: Slime name
screen.slimic.recommended_warning: Above the recommended range; you can still apply.
screen.slimic.roster.gather_help: Spend 25 stamina to gather living, released companions with this tag. They arrive waiting. Mounted and stored companions are excluded.
screen.slimic.roster.primary_only: The primary owner controls player relationships.
screen.slimic.roster.tag_help: Select a companion to assign a tag. Gather uses the typed tag. Blank means untagged companions. Tags ignore letter case.
screen.slimic.saddle_help:
Gear: saddle, elytra, slime armor
Slime Tuner: management
Right-click: mount
WASD/look: steer / Space: ascend
Ctrl: boost / Shift: dismount
screen.slimic.soggy_info: Follow or roam to leave trails. Roam stays near its starting point within Detection Range. Each trail costs 1 stamina. Craft 4 Slime Slag into 1 slimeball.
screen.slimic.sort_bag.tooltip: Merge matching stacks and sort every bag page. Equipment stays in place.
screen.slimic.specialization_stat: Used by another slime type; upgrades remain saved.
screen.slimic.specialize: Craft a Friendly or Attention Slime with other ingredients to specialize it. Recipes are listed in the guide.
screen.slimic.synthesis.excludes: Only verified growth transfers. Base attributes, ancient passives, and equipment do not become points. Both parents are consumed.
screen.slimic.tuner_help: Edit base stats without gameplay caps. Guardian Angel/Royal Guard Health ×4; Attention Movement Speed ×1.5. Role multipliers still apply. Amber values exceed recommendations.
screen.slimic.tunnel_size.help: Enter a positive whole number n for an n×n bore. Changing the size sets the slime to Wait mode. The face and its lining must fit within the world's height limits.
screen.slimic.tunnel_size.note: Changing the size sets the slime to Wait mode.
screen.slimic.upgrade_tooltip: Spend one stat point to upgrade this stat.

jei.slimic.abundance_slime: Craft a Healing Slime with bone meal and a nether star. Starts waiting; select Nurture. Treats companions before encouraging plant growth. Treatment needs slimeballs; each growth attempt uses 2 stamina and no bone meal.
jei.slimic.ancient_command_seal: Find seals in ruin chests or obtain one by defeating a ruin remnant with a player or tamed companion. Use with a ruin core and slimeball for restoration, or combine with a Combat Slime to obtain a Royal Guard.
jei.slimic.ancient_mining_slime: Obtain a mining core from collapsed mines or Forgotten Mining Slimes. Restore in the Overworld with an Old Command Fragment and a slimeball. Starts waiting at 1 health. Prioritizes ores in its current layer and halves work and movement stamina costs.
jei.slimic.ancient_tunnel_slime: Obtain a tunnel core from collapsed mines or Forgotten Tunnel Slimes. Restore in the Overworld with an Old Command Fragment and a slimeball. Starts waiting at 1 health. Halves stamina costs and works ancient Slimic masonry 50% faster with an effective tool.
jei.slimic.assembly.path: Find an Assembly Chamber in The Slimic and use its core to begin. Claim personal rewards at a core after defeating the colony. A Colony Heart crafts a reusable bonding station. The guide explains entry, rewards, and the Peaceful alternative.
jei.slimic.attention_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with redstone dust. Starts waiting; Roam moves playfully near its owner. Movement Speed is 50% higher at the same base stat. Basic specialization recipes retain its invested stats but remove Attention behavior and its speed bonus.
jei.slimic.bonding.controls: Insert two recovered companions to Bind, or one recovered colony to Unbind.
jei.slimic.bonding.members: Match ordinary Transport or Combat Slimes with the same primary owner. Both records are preserved.
jei.slimic.bonding.safety: Reusable station. Unbind into two safe spaces, retaining remaining health and stamina.
jei.slimic.bound_combat_slime: Bind two ordinary Combat Slimes with the same primary owner at a Colony Bonding Station. The colony combines their health and sets its base Attack to 60% of their combined Attack values. It uses member one's equipment. Both bodies display its armor; member two's original armor stays stored until unbinding.
jei.slimic.bound_transport_slime: Bind two ordinary Transport Slimes with the same primary owner at a Colony Bonding Station. Their real capacities combine under one order. Unbind to restore the original two identities.
jei.slimic.cleaning_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with rotten flesh. Starts waiting; select Clean to collect dropped items around its release point. Has five times the common Detection Range and requests cargo pickup when full.
jei.slimic.combat_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a sword. Starts waiting; select Fight and choose target types. Can equip a sword, shield, and Slime Armor. Allies are protected; creepers are excluded by default.
jei.slimic.command_pedestal: Find an intact station in ruins or craft one. Hold a damaged core and right-click with a slimeball and its matching seal or fragment in your inventory. Mine cores require the Overworld. Cracked stations cannot restore cores.
jei.slimic.commander_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a book. Starts waiting. Manage companion records, tags, and sharing; Gather spends 25 stamina and arrivals wait. Only the primary owner changes relationships. One released Command Slime per connected shared-owner group.
jei.slimic.creative_slime_tuner: Creative-only editing of base stats, current health and stamina, and unused points. Recommendations are advisory. Use finite numbers and whole slot/point counts; empty affected bag slots before reducing Capacity.
jei.slimic.damaged_ancient_slime_core: Restore a core at a Slime Restoration Station with a slimeball and its matching seal or fragment. Mine cores require the Overworld. Each core restores once, yielding a new owned companion waiting at 1 health with 12–28 invested stat points.
jei.slimic.dragon_slime: Craft a Combat Slime with a dragon head. Starts waiting; equip a sword and select Fight for flying attacks and flame breath. Keeps Combat Slime target filters and equipment. Breath can ignite enemies without burning terrain.
jei.slimic.ender_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with an ender pearl. Starts waiting. At full stamina, right-click empty-handed with a free inventory slot to anchor it and receive a teleporter. Linking and travel each spend full stamina. Follow releases the anchor.
jei.slimic.farmer_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a hoe. Starts waiting; select Farm to register nearby farmland. Harvests, replants from its bag, and repairs registered farmland. Supply a hoe and matching seeds or plantable produce.
jei.slimic.fishing_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a fishing rod. Starts waiting with that rod; select Fish near a shore. Catches enter its bag. Rod enchantments apply, and treasure requires open water. Carriers can unload cargo or replace a broken rod.
jei.slimic.friendly_slime: Use the item, or feed a golden apple to the smallest wild slime. Starts waiting. Manage it with a Slime Tuner; Shift-right-click to recover it. A slimeball heals up to 4 health, and a water bucket removes dye.
jei.slimic.glow_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with glowstone dust. Starts waiting with torch-strength light on. Light costs no stamina. Right-click for six-second fireflies at a cost of 10 stamina.
jei.slimic.guardian_angel_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a nether star and a totem of undying. Starts waiting, but can retaliate and protect its owner. A stored totem prevents lethal owner damage within 16 blocks. Maximum health is four times the common value.
jei.slimic.healing_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a golden carrot. Starts waiting; select Search to treat allied companions. Each treatment uses a slimeball and 1 stamina to heal up to 4 health or revive a Broken Slime at 1 health.
jei.slimic.herald_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a firework rocket. Starts waiting; select Watch to report blocked work after the chosen delay. Reuses the saved firework and tells owners the companion’s name and interruption cause.
jei.slimic.lumberjack_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with an axe. Starts waiting; select Chop to fell natural trees and replant them. Before cutting, it reserves one matching sapling from its bag for each stump.
jei.slimic.meow_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with raw cod, raw salmon, a tropical fish, or a pufferfish. Starts Active and waiting. Repels nearby creepers while active; movement and activation are separate. A creeper already ignited may still explode.
jei.slimic.mining_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a pickaxe. Starts waiting; select Mine to excavate its release chunk. Equip tools; keep an empty bucket and cobblestone in its bag. Fluid removal does not fill or consume the bucket.
jei.slimic.next_generation_mining_slime: At a Royal Synthesis Station, combine recovered ordinary and Ancient Mining Slimes with 4 slimeballs and 2 Old Command Fragments. You must be their primary owner; empty gear and bags. Starts waiting with unused growth points and half stamina costs. Precision Prospecting digs 2×2 routes to selected ores.
jei.slimic.next_generation_tunnel_slime: At a Royal Synthesis Station, combine recovered ordinary and Ancient Tunnel Slimes with 4 slimeballs and 2 Old Command Fragments. You must be their primary owner; empty gear and bags. Starts waiting with unused growth points and ancient efficiency. Set side length n in the Tuner for an n×n tunnel.
jei.slimic.old_command_fragment: Found in collapsed-mine supply chests and dropped when a player or tamed companion defeats a mine remnant. Use with a mine core and a slimeball at a Slime Restoration Station in the Overworld.
jei.slimic.restoration.title: Slime Restoration
jei.slimic.royal_guard_slime: Craft a Combat Slime with an Ancient Command Seal, or restore a guard core. Starts waiting; select Fight to guard its post. With a shield, it takes 35% of nearby allies’ combat damage and spends stamina.
jei.slimic.saddle_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a saddle. Starts waiting. Right-click to ride; use a Tuner to manage gear. Elytra enable flight. Flight and boost (default Ctrl) spend stamina; exhaustion causes slow descent.
jei.slimic.sanctum.path: Find map fragments in newly generated mines and ruins in The Slimic. Combine three, use the map in The Slimic, and explore a Fallen Sanctum. Restore both chamber memories and clear the deep chamber to claim its single shared Royal Synthesis Core.
jei.slimic.slime_armor: Craft a chestplate with a slimeball. Preserves its material, wear, enchantments, and dye. Equip it in a Combat, Dragon, or Saddle Slime’s armor slot.
jei.slimic.slime_chest: Craft eight wooden planks around a slimeball. Holds 27 stacks of cargo and supplies for transport companions. Ordinary chests are not used by automatic transport.
jei.slimic.slime_scanner: Place a Slime Tuner in the center with glass directly above, below, left, and right. Right-click a companion you can manage to preview its work area for 15 seconds. Keep the scanner in either hand to see the outline.
jei.slimic.slime_tuner: Place a slimeball directly above an iron ingot. Right-click a companion to manage its name, orders, equipment, bag, and stat upgrades. Use a Slime Scanner to view work areas.
jei.slimic.soggy_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a slimeball. Starts waiting. Follow and Roam leave trails at a stamina cost. Each trail drops one Slime Slag; combine four slag into a slimeball.
jei.slimic.synthesis.controls: Insert recovered parents and reagents. Preview, then confirm at the station.
jei.slimic.synthesis.refund: Both parents are consumed. All verified growth points return as unused points; invested levels reset.
jei.slimic.synthesis.safety: Primary ownership of both parents is required. Empty all equipment and cargo first.
jei.slimic.transport_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a chest. Starts waiting; select Haul to collect requested cargo and supply tools or materials. Uses Warehouse Slimes and Slime Chests. Capacity is twice that of an ordinary companion with the same stats.
jei.slimic.tunnel_slime: Craft a Mining Slime with a regular minecart. Starts waiting. Choose a direction and lining template, then select Tunnel to dig a 3×3 passage. Supply tools, lining blocks, and an empty bucket for fluids. The template is not consumed.
jei.slimic.warehouse_slime: Craft a Transport Slime with eight chests. Starts waiting; select Store to collect cargo and supply workers from its own bag. Capacity is four times that of a Transport Slime with the same stats. Other carriers prefer it over Slime Chests.
jei.slimic.world_building: Gather materials in The Slimic. Use a crafting table for masonry, shaped parts, and decorations; add vines or moss for mossy stone, or smelt bricks and tiles to crack them. Stonecutters remain available.
book.slimic.guide.landing: Learn to raise slime companions, assign work, and build a cooperative team. Start with a Friendly Slime and a Slime Tuner.
book.slimic.guide.name: Slimic Companion Guide
book.slimic.guide.subtitle: Growth & Teamwork
lore.slimic.archive.page1: At first, only our slime trails joined the two stores. The path grew wider as we went back and forth. More slimes came. XXX called this place a kingdom. I wrote that word in wet clay.
lore.slimic.archive.page2: XXX said they would come back, then crossed the green arch. Each morning I opened a blank page. The carriers brought only old crates. The road was empty again today. I left the promise on the clay.
lore.slimic.archive.title: Waiting for XXX
lore.slimic.royal.page1: We were told to guard the work yard until XXX came back. No other order followed. Our gold bands cracked, but the little slimes still hid behind us. The high stone seat was empty. I stayed by the flag.
lore.slimic.royal.page2: A young slime with a sword put an old seal on its shield. It stopped a stone meant for a carrier. Its scars were still there. If I fall apart, I hope someone leaves my seal beside the piece that still moves.
lore.slimic.royal.title: The Last Watch
lore.slimic.royal_archives.author: Royal Archives
lore.slimic.sanctum.core.page1: The last guardian waited for a call that never came. I left both seals in the sanctum memory. There was only one royal core. We were told it could leave after the watch ended. We had no other core to replace it.
lore.slimic.sanctum.core.page2: We once stood a core on three bricks. We used gold, redstone and an ancient seal too. XXX asked if an order would stay after they were gone. I did not know. Outside, the other slimes kept working.
lore.slimic.sanctum.core.title: The Order That Remains
lore.slimic.sanctum.courtyard.page1: I counted the shields again. Three stood beside the broken cart. The order said we needed nine at the gate. Our carriers did not answer. XXX had not come since the lamps went out.
lore.slimic.sanctum.courtyard.page2: We pressed the courtyard seal into the relay. Its memory stayed even when we left the seal behind. I went past the fallen banners and through a narrow gap. The command gallery was on the other side.
lore.slimic.sanctum.courtyard.title: The Gate Still Holds
lore.slimic.sanctum.gallery.page1: In the morning we were told to guard the inner gate. In the evening we were told to open it for XXX. Both orders had the same mark. Our commander kept saying both. We pushed and struck each other at the gate.
lore.slimic.sanctum.gallery.page2: I carried the survey needle up the stairs and back down. It kept pointing through the wall. We found the quiet room after turning past the shelves. We left the gallery seal in the second relay. The deep device needed the courtyard memory too.
lore.slimic.sanctum.gallery.title: Two Final Orders
lore.slimic.sanctum.laboratory.page1: The old mining slime held out its core. The young one settled beside it. We put down their picks and emptied their bags. We took off everything they wore. They could not enter the rings with anything on them.
lore.slimic.sanctum.laboratory.page2: Four slimeballs and two old command fragments steadied the rings. The two slimes did not come back. Their learned strength stayed with the new child, but it had to learn how to use it. The royal core lay down the passage, beneath the last watch.
lore.slimic.sanctum.laboratory.title: A Body for Two Memories
lore.slimic.supply_ledger.page1: The north workshop was waiting for supplies again. I rolled an empty crate to the gate. Only eight stones were left in the lower chest. We kept one road open.
lore.slimic.supply_ledger.page2: We left the lamps on so XXX could find the way back. The last mark pointed beyond the green arch. Rain washed the road away. No one told us to put out the lights.
lore.slimic.supply_ledger.page3: The slime guarding the dais fell apart beside it. I found its core in the gel. I set the core, its seal, and a little of our gel on the unbroken dais. The core moved. I waited beside it.
lore.slimic.supply_ledger.title: The Interrupted Ledger
record.slimic.endless_assembly.1: Three slime trails met at the chamber. We hung lamps by the stairs. We had brought no seal. We could still go inside.
record.slimic.endless_assembly.2: I saw many faces in the great heap. When a little piece returned, a wound closed. The places left by broken pieces stayed empty. I remembered those gaps.
record.slimic.endless_assembly.3: Two slimes wanted to stay together. I watched them join into one small body. I could still see both cores. When they parted, they remembered their names. I still did not know why XXX had left.
record.slimic.last_rally.1: We heard the call to gather. The carriers put down their packs. The fighters folded their flags. We left a way open for XXX to come back.
record.slimic.last_rally.2: No one told us to leave. Our bodies touched. Our cores began saying the same words. I counted the slimes beside me. I could still tell how many there were then.
record.slimic.last_rally.3: The little cores tried to return to the great body. When we stopped them, fewer wounds closed. Our blades could still hurt it. We kept the stairs clear. I wanted a way back.
